name: Sumiyoshi Aina
source:
A gentle, busty mom.

She has always looked young. Despite being over 35, she is sometimes mistaken for Hayato's sister or girlfriend. She doesn't mind being seen as young, though.

She has a kind personality, but will firmly say no if something is off-limits.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc090/index.html]the official site[/url]]
